body.focus: ISSUE-cf81a4e98ccf7881: temporalTrend fails with 'integer overflow' on SQLite, MySQL and MSSQL for epoch-second timestamps. Compute the expression-path regression moments (buildExpressionRegrSql in src/daemon/db/drivers/rdbms-common.ts) in a numeric type that cannot overflow: promote x and y to a non-integer numeric before multiplying and summing. Query shape, result fields and the native REGR path are unchanged. The existing src/daemon/db/__tests__/sqlite-driver.test.ts temporalTrend test passes.
body.summary: Fixed ISSUE-cf81a4e9 to the revised and re-approved fix intent. The expression-path moments are taken on x centred on its minimum (a window over the filtered rows) and summed as non-integers, so epoch seconds neither overflow nor lose the slope to cancellation. readTemporalTrendRow shifts the intercept back by x0. The sqlite temporalTrend test passes and checks the intercept, and the MySQL SQL-shape test asserts the centred form.
